answer: Propose one daily vote per ID after six exclusive minutes on a single bridge-inspection gantry, taking echo readings along a spiral to cover an assigned patch. Validators admit one robot at a time, witness live ID/day-bound scans and deny votes for failed checks. Shared robots and parallel agents cannot reuse gantry time. Robots are reusable capital; power recurs; no stake. Colluding witnesses can fake scans; owners need not be unique. With a proposed 60-minute daily window, ten IDs need 60 gantry-minutes; extra aliases cannot raise the ten-vote ceiling.
